name: Fauna
source:
A passenger in the observation car.
A lady with a telescope in her hand, observing the stars shining in the night sky through the glass ceiling of the observation car.
She is dressed almost bare-chested, with a hat on her head, long hair covering her face, and her eyes hidden by a mask. She is dressed as if she were attending a drunken medieval ball, but none of the passengers feel uncomfortable. It is a woman who makes those who see her think that she looks natural, as if the trees need water.
Beyond the darkness, she is familiar with the stars shining in the night sky.
